Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Al-Ghazali as the historian whose work Bousquet translated, despite the WebSurfer results explicitly mentioning both Al-Ghazali (a theologian) and Ibn Khaldun (a Tunisian historian). The task specifically asked for the heritage of the historian, and Ibn Khaldun is clearly identified as a Tunisian historian in the WebSurfer results. The Planner failed to focus on Ibn Khaldun and instead attributed the heritage of Al-Ghazali, leading to the wrong answer.
